items.label: Reduce waste and recycle
items.text: You try to reduce your waste and you regularly separate it for recycling
items.option: Wynes and Nicholas (2017), recycling for a year

items.label: Cut down on disposable items
items.text: You try to cut down on your consumption of disposable items whenever possible (e.g. plastic bags from the supermarket, excess packaging, plastic cutlery etc.)

items.label: Weigh energy use of appliances
items.text: When buying a new household appliance (e.g. washing machine, fridge or TV), lower energy consumption is an important factor in your choice

items.label: Use alternatives to the car
items.text: You regularly use environmentally-friendly alternatives to your private car such as walking, cycling, taking public transport or car-sharing
items.option: shift to public transport, walking and cycling, or car sharing

items.label: Eat less meat
items.text: You buy and eat less meat

items.label: Insulated the home
items.text: You have insulated your home better to reduce your energy consumption

items.label: Adapt long-distance travel
items.text: You consider the carbon footprint of your transport when planning your holiday and other longer distance travel and sometimes adapt your plans accordingly

items.label: Switched to a greener supplier
items.text: You have switched to an energy supplier which offers a greater share of energy from renewable sources than your previous one

items.label: Installed energy controls
items.text: You have installed equipment in your home to control and reduce your energy consumption (e.g. smart meter)

items.label: Installed solar panels
items.text: You have installed solar panels in your home

items.label: New car chosen for low fuel use
items.text: You have bought a new car and its low fuel consumption was an important factor in your choice

items.label: Installed a heat pump
items.text: You have installed a heat pump to reduce your energy bill and carbon footprint

items.label: Bought an electric car
items.text: You have bought an electric car
items.option: shift to a battery electric car

items.label: Bought a low-energy home
items.text: You have bought a low-energy home
